name: Exp_StepSto_v1
summary: This EA trades based on the StepSto_v1 custom indicator, which appears to be a stepped stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the fast line crosses above the slow line above the 50 level, and sell positions when the fast line crosses below the slow line below the 50 level. Positions are closed on opposing signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于StepSto_v1自定义指标（阶梯随机振荡器）进行交易。当快速线在50水平以上向上穿越慢速线时开多仓，当快速线在50水平以下向下穿越慢速线时开空仓。反向信号出现时平仓，并使用固定止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于阶梯随机指标（StepSto_v1）的动量交叉策略。入场条件为：当慢速线Ma2大于50时，若快速线Ma1从下方穿越Ma1向上则买入开仓；当慢速线Ma2小于50时，若快速线Ma1从上方穿越Ma2向下则卖出开仓。50水平线作为多空分界线，高于50为多头区域，低于50为空头区域。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号平仓，同时配合固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，策略本身未包含加仓或减仓逻辑。信号仅在NewBar时检测，避免同一根K线内重复触发。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a momentum crossover strategy based on the StepSto_v1 custom stepped stochastic indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the slow line Ma2 is above 50 and the fast line Ma1 crosses above Ma2; a sell signal triggers when Ma2 is below 50 and Ma1 crosses below Ma2. The 50 level serves as a bull/bear threshold, with values above 50 considered bullish territory and below 50 bearish. Exit conditions rely on opposing crossover signals for position closure, supplemented by fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values calculate lots as a share of the deposit. Money management is delegated to the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions. The strategy lacks position scaling logic such as pyramiding or partial closes. Signal detection only occurs on new bars, preventing repeated triggers within the same candle.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter for lot calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用NewBar机制检测信号，避免同一K线内重复交易
50水平线作为多空过滤，减少震荡行情中的假信号
买入和卖出的开仓与平仓权限可独立控制，灵活性高
固定止损止盈提供基本的风险控制保护
信号检测失败时设置Recount标志，确保下一tick重新计算
pros_en: NewBar mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same candle
50-level filter reduces false signals in choppy markets
Independent permission switches for buy/sell open/close offer high flexibility
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide basic risk control
Recount flag on CopyBuffer failure ensures signal recalculation on next tick
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不可见，难以审计风险
Kfast和Kslow默认值均为1.0，两者相同时指标实际退化为单线，策略可能失效
没有点差过滤，震荡行情中频繁交叉可能产生过多交易
止损1000点和止盈2000点相对较大，可能在波动市场中承受较大回撤
缺少对已有持仓的检查逻辑，可能重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, making core trading logic unauditable
Kfast and Kslow both default to 1.0, which collapses the indicator to a single line and may invalidate the strategy
No spread filter, frequent crossovers in ranging markets can generate excessive trades
StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are large, potentially allowing significant drawdowns
Lacks explicit position existence checks before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions
improvements: 增加点差和波动率过滤条件，避免在高成本或低波动环境下频繁交易
对Kfast和Kslow参数添加输入验证，确保两者不相等时策略才有意义
improvements_en: Add spread and volatility filters to avoid excessive trading in high-cost or low-volatility environments
Add input validation for Kfast and Kslow to ensure the strategy is meaningful only when they differ

risk_points: 外部库TradeAlgorithms.mqh的仓位管理逻辑不可审计，存在未知风险
Kfast=Kslow时指标退化为单线，策略可能产生错误信号
大止损值(1000点)在极端行情中可能造成重大亏损
risk_points_en: External TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management logic is unauditable, posing unknown risks
When Kfast equals Kslow the indicator degenerates to a single line, potentially generating erroneous signals
Large stop loss (1000 points) can cause significant losses during extreme market moves
